comments.text:
I think my favorite part about your recent karaoke is having me truly appreciate the potential of your voice. The way you can go so gentle/melancholic to cutieful/adorable and to handsome/deep is insane to me. Your voice is also so emotive when you sing, you really capture the feelings of the songs perfectly and manage to resonate those emotions inside of me. Honestly felt so full yesterday like I ate a full course meal with all the flavors of you 😋🍽️ (which I can eat everyday tbh 🫣🤤)

I really do love your voice and hope you continue to find the confidence and fun of singing live. I think the charm of live singing is appreciating the rawness and imperfections without all the fine tuning. Also just like any skill, it just takes time to hone and master it. So no matter how many times I have to repeat it, I will continue to admire & praise you by letting you know your voice is wonderful, your singing is wonderful, and you are wonderful (and cutieful)!~🫵💖 Please praise yourself, be proud, and be more confident about your live singing as much as I love you or else-💥💚💥💥💥
